'''Jannitha Xoczuko''' was a [[Czerialan]] [[Gender|female]] [[droid]] [[programmer]] who worked for the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation]]. She lived on [[Corellia]] with [[Xoczuko family|her family]], but was unhappy with the conditions of the military industry. She planned to move back to her [[homeworld]] [[Czerialus]].<ref name="Solo Guide" />
